_note: Invented data for screen-share demos. Nothing here is a real person, company, or message. Day fields are offsets from today (negative is past); setup converts them to dates: added_days, due_days, done_days, ask_days, as_of_days (to YYYY-MM-DD as added_date, due_date, done_date, ask_date, as_of), waiting_days (waiting_since), created_days and sent_days (ISO 8601 created_at and sent_at). Times are a day offset plus a local HH:MM: meetings use start_days, start_time, and minutes (to start and end); slots use the same fields (to start and end). No source links, so nothing on screen opens a real mailbox. meta.config lists only the fields demo mode adds to the normal config: sections turns on the optional board sections.
